name: Proving Grounds 25: The Sky Harbor. A harbour on the rim of an island, taken by sky pirates: two long piers and a cross pier run out over the open sky, every way out is a narrow deck with a drop on both sides, and their sky-ship is moored at the end, its deck the high ground, one gangplank up.
